experimental_design: Both lanes are new synthetic-only mechanism studies. No external source data, model calls, broker, private records, prior Wingless/Yggdrasil heldouts, accepted-ref mutation or source reclassification.

Wingless.hypothesis: A learner that identifies six primitive affine roles from four training examples per role and composes two roles in order generalizes to heldout first-input states; reversing the role order or canonicalizing role order degrades exact-match accuracy.
Wingless.validity: All four disjoint heldout seeds, exact 192 evaluations per seed, no exact first-input overlap with any role's four fitting inputs; generator and transform identities frozen; no unseen labels used for fitting.
Wingless.falsification: Any clause false on valid evidence is MIXED or NEGATIVE rather than retuned. Missing data/seed/budget/source proof is INVALID.

Yggdrasil.hypothesis: With a 9-slot memory and a protected subset of six slots chosen during original 12-key acquisition (before knowing which 9 keys will become hot), protected memory retains more cold keys after a shifting 9-key hot workload than pure 9-slot LRU, without extra slots or external hints.
Yggdrasil.validity: All eight independent heldout seeds, each 9-hot/3-cold split determined only after frozen acquisition, exact eight cycles over nine keys, 12 heldout tests per seed; memory allocation and budgets constant across arms. Evaluation labels not leaked during acquisition or policy selection.
Yggdrasil.falsification: Any clause false on valid evidence remains MIXED/NEGATIVE; bad evidence is INVALID. Synthetic-only positive never external generalization.

global_controls.infrastructure: GitHub-hosted sandbox runner, read-only contents, bounded CPU/time, no sensitive credentials
